items.text: Employability skills for graduates are the practical abilities that employers look for beyond a degree: clear communication, digital and data skills, problem solving, teamwork, adaptability and professional habits, and each can be shown through small projects and examples.
Read live notices and prepare for the tests used in your target sector.
